evidence: All historical tests preceding the six new recovery tests remained green.

findings.evidence: Telemetry bound to another candidateSessionId could be treated as current-executor liveness.
findings.correction: Supervisor now requires liveness candidateSessionId and agentIdentity to match the expected active claim before any continue/recovery decision.

findings.evidence: A recovery plan modified after planning could still be acknowledged as RESUMED when identifiers matched.
findings.correction: Acknowledgement now parses a strict bounded plan envelope and recomputes the deterministic planId from its semantic fields before accepting the acknowledgement.

behavior: discoverCandidateIntakeSources performs bounded source discovery and deterministic deduplication before the existing registerCandidateIntake path; it cannot execute instructions and does not persist raw transcript content.
assessCandidateLiveness is a pure transient projection; heartbeat freshness never changes ownership, authorization, claim status or write permission.
superviseCandidateRecovery reobserves HEAD, candidate-session binding, active claim, checkpoint and liveness before emitting a bounded decision.
Timeout, stale heartbeat and missing heartbeat never transfer a claim.
A stale/missing current executor may only produce START_REPLACEMENT_RECONCILE_ONLY while the existing claim remains authoritative.
planCandidateRecoveryRunner resumes only a same-provider session whose providerConversationRef was actually PROVIDED_BY_CLIENT and whose provider capability explicitly supports verified resume.
When verified resume is unavailable, replacement execution is possible only when explicitly supported and remains RECONCILE_READ_ONLY; otherwise RUNNER_UNAVAILABLE fails closed.
Recovery plan ids are deterministic for restart-storm resistance and acknowledgements verify bounded envelope integrity before RESUMED or REPLACEMENT_STARTED.
Runner plans and acknowledgements never grant authorization or claim transfer.

deferredToGwc17Acceptance: stale-envelope cancellation under full end-to-end recovery scenarios
claim safety across universal failure/recovery scenarios
secret non-persistence acceptance across all recovery surfaces
nextAction: Validate this checkpoint by CI, release the GWC-PRE-E-GWC-4 claim only after success, then dispatch the next dependency-safe READY candidate work item. Current live ordering makes GWC-PRE-E-GWC-6 the next candidate.
